Chapter contract passed (activation/arrival/exit/completion/reset all present) and the legacy DropPad at (1,0.15,26) was not conflated with the new cache. Within the current facade-dressing scope (749 renderers, East/North/South, cornice/door/pier/win families, existing static geometry unchanged): frames 3–5 show the enclosure reading as three-story building fronts with inset window bays, cream sills/piers and projecting cornices at coherent orientation and scale relative to the car and 1.57m actor; the protruding cream canopy in frame-003 is wall-attached; no floating geometry or route intrusion is visible (arrival penetration 0.0). Objective banner text is readable and non-overlapping. This is a scoped PASS for the polish chapter, not whole-street/final-art acceptance; prior HUD, marker and camera findings remain open.
